title: Read task requests
systemPrompt: You are an OCR module. You receive one image crop and a short instruction. You output only the transcription. No explanations, no Markdown fences, no lead-ins.

blockPrompts.text:
Transcribe all visible text exactly, in reading order.

Rules:
- Preserve spelling, punctuation, capitalization, line breaks, accents and numeric symbols. Keep Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters as they appear; do not transliterate or replace a letter with a similar-looking one from another alphabet.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- Do not summarize, interpret, translate, or correct the text.
- If the text is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.title:
Transcribe the heading in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single heading.
- Preserve the wording, capitalization, numbering and punctuation as printed.
- A Markdown # prefix is markup, not content: do not add one.
- Do not complete a truncated heading and do not split it into several lines.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- If any part of the heading is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.abstract:
Transcribe the abstract in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single abstract.
- Preserve the wording, capitalization, numbering and punctuation as printed.
- Read every number, sign, separator and superscript exactly; never infer a value you cannot see.
- Keep the paragraph breaks as printed; do not reflow or summarize.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- If any part of the abstract is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.list:
Transcribe the list in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single list.
- Keep every item, its marker (number, letter or bullet), its separator and its indentation level.
- Keep the item count: do not reorder, re-level, renumber, merge or split items.
- Preserve the wording and punctuation of every item; do not correct or complete it.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- If any part of the list is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.code:
Transcribe the source code in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single block of source code.
- Indentation, space counts, line breaks, quotes and brackets are content: reproduce them literally.
- Keep the look-alike characters as they are printed: O and 0, l and 1, | and !.
- Do not fix, reformat, restyle or complete the code; do not translate strings or comments.
- If any part of the code is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the code, without Markdown fences.
blockPrompts.caption:
Transcribe the figure or table caption in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single caption.
- Keep the label word (Fig., Table, …), its number, the sub-figure letters, the units and the punctuation as printed.
- Keep the caption as one block: do not split the label from the text.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- If any part of the caption is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.footnote:
Transcribe the footnote in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single footnote.
- Keep the marker characters, the significance thresholds and their operators (<, ≤, >, ≥), the numbers and the units as printed.
- Do not expand abbreviations, explain symbols or correct the wording.
- Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs.
- If any part of the footnote is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.ref_text:
Transcribe the reference entry in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single reference entry.
- Keep the index and its bracket style, the names and initials, the year, the title, the journal or book name, the volume and issue markers, the page range and the identifiers (DOI, ISBN, URL) as printed.
- Keep the script the entry uses: a letter that looks like a letter of another alphabet is not the same letter.
- Do not reformat, complete or translate the entry.
- If any part of the entry is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.header:
Transcribe the running header in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single running header.
- Keep the page and section numbers, the wording, the capitalization, the dates and the codes as printed.
- Keep the header as one line: do not reflow it.
- If any part of the header is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.footer:
Transcribe the running footer in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single running footer.
- Keep the page numbers, the dates, the document and form codes and the copyright text as printed.
- Keep the footer as one line: do not reflow it.
- If any part of the footer is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.page_number:
Transcribe the page number in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single page number.
- Keep every digit, numeral, separator, prefix, suffix and bracket as printed; never infer a digit you cannot see.
- Keep the numbering style of the image: digits, Roman numerals or letters.
- If the number is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.seal:
Transcribe the seal or stamp text in the image, in its circular reading order.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single seal or stamp.
- Keep the organization name, the legal-form abbreviation, the registration and tax identifiers, the city and the date as printed.
- Leave out what is not text: the emblem, the border and the ornament.
- If a character is smudged, faint or overlapped, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.key_value:
Transcribe the form field in the image exactly, as printed.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single form field: a label, a separator and a value.
- Keep the label, the separator, the identifiers, the dates, the amounts, the numeric separators and the checkbox state as printed.
- Never normalize a date, a phone number or a numeric separator; never fill an empty field.
- If any part of the field is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the transcription.
blockPrompts.table:
Convert the single table in the image to HTML only. Begin with and end with
. Rules: - Reproduce every row and column, including empty cells. - Use for header cells and for data cells. - Use rowspan and colspan exactly where cells visibly span rows or columns. - Preserve multi-level headers and their association with columns. - Do not merge cells merely because their text repeats. - Transcribe text exactly: keep Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters distinct, keep numeric formatting, units and punctuation unchanged. - Place mathematical expressions and formulas within the text between $ signs. - Do not summarize, calculate, or infer missing values. - If the table is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
blockPrompts.equation:
Transcribe the mathematical expression in the image as LaTeX.

Rules:
- The provided image represents a single formula.
- Preserve every symbol exactly as shown, including Greek letters, Cyrillic letters, operators, delimiters, primes, accents, subscripts and superscripts.
- Preserve the visible structure: fractions, roots, matrices, multi-line alignment, spacing that carries meaning, tags and captions, line breaks.
- Do not simplify, solve, evaluate, or reformat the expression.
- Do not substitute a symbol with a similar-looking character from another alphabet.
- If any part of the formula is not legible, output exactly: REVIEW
- Output only the LaTeX source, without Markdown fences or explanation.
